name: GAP tan cream check flannel shirt
description: Long-sleeve GAP button-down in a large muted tan-and-cream check with a chest pocket; fabric looks brushed cotton or light flannel. Heavy wear with a large front hole, collar yellowing, and staining.
rating_reason: Colors are Soft Autumn gold, but the hole and stains make it unsuitable for a curated capsule—chore rag at best.

name: Dusty rose muscle tank
description: Sleeveless cotton jersey muscle tee in muted dusty rose with a ribbed crew neck and small left-chest patch pocket. Relaxed straight fit with wide armholes.
rating_reason: Muted warm pink is Soft Autumn friendly; wide shoulders help balance hips. Easy summer homestead layer when tucked.

name: Oatmeal These Are The Days hoodie
description: Light oatmeal fleece hoodie with white drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs/hem, and a white retro script graphic reading These Are The Days on the chest.
rating_reason: Warm neutral Soft Autumn staple and cozy for homestead days; boxy cut needs a tuck or layer for waist definition.

name: Olive ribbed V-neck sweater
description: Long-sleeve V-neck knit in muted olive with vertical ribbing through body and sleeves. Relaxed straight hem silhouette.
rating_reason: Signature Soft Autumn green plus a V-neck that lifts the eye; cozy layering hero for pear balance.

name: Marled oatmeal V-neck sweater
description: Relaxed long-sleeve V-neck in marled oatmeal/taupe knit with ribbed cuffs and hem. Medium-gauge textured, slightly rustic look.
rating_reason: Perfect Soft Autumn neutral with a flattering V; soft staple for layering over tees or under jackets.

name: Terracotta button-detail sweatshirt
description: Muted terracotta crew sweatshirt with diagonal shoulder-to-chest button plackets (three dark buttons each side), ribbed cuffs and hem. Slightly boxy relaxed fit.
rating_reason: Earthy Soft Autumn color and shoulder interest help balance hips; boxy cut still needs styling at the waist.

name: Black raglan crew sweatshirt
description: Solid black long-sleeve crew sweatshirt with raglan sleeves, ribbed crew neck, and thick ribbed hem. Classic boxy casual cut.
rating_reason: Practical for dirt and laundry but stark black clashes with Soft Autumn and adds no waist definition for pear.

name: Medium-wash denim trucker jacket
description: Classic trucker denim jacket in muted medium wash with collar, silver buttons, dual chest flap pockets, waist welt pockets, gold contrast stitching, and light jersey lining.
rating_reason: Muted wash works Soft Autumn; structured shoulders balance hips and denim is homestead durable.

name: Tomato red jersey maxi skirt
description: Solid warm red-orange knit maxi/midi skirt with a wide flat waistband and full gathered flare. Lightweight stretch jersey with soft drape.
rating_reason: Volume over hips is pear-friendly and warm-toned, but saturation is brighter than classic Soft Autumn muteds.

name: Burgundy crew-neck sweater
description: Deep burgundy/maroon long-sleeve crew sweater with fine knit texture and a horizontal seam across the upper chest. Simple ribbed crew neck.
rating_reason: Cozy practical staple, but deep cool burgundy is only a fair Soft Autumn match and the crew is neutrally pear.

name: Olive shorts with tan waistband
description: Muted olive woven shorts with a wide contrasting tan fold-over comfort/maternity-style elastic waistband, front slash pockets, and finished hems.
rating_reason: Core Soft Autumn olive/tan and post-baby comfort waist; practical summer homestead bottoms.

name: Red navy plaid cinched tunic
description: Long-sleeve button-down plaid tunic/short dress with collar, dual flap chest pockets, and an elastic cinched waist with slight peplum flare. Lightweight woven flannel-like fabric.
rating_reason: Cinched waist is excellent for pear and homestead-practical, but high-contrast bright red/navy is only fair Soft Autumn.

name: Charcoal gray striped scoop tank
description: Sleeveless scoop-neck tank in fine horizontal charcoal and heather-gray stripes with self-fabric binding at neck and armholes. Soft lightweight knit with some pilling.
rating_reason: Cool gray stripes sit outside Soft Autumn warmth; wearable basic only if needed.

name: Beige utility jacket with drawstring
description: Warm beige utility jacket with stand collar, metal snap front, large lower flap pockets, and an internal waist drawstring for cinching. Durable cotton-blend look.
rating_reason: Soft Autumn neutral with adjustable waist—ideal pear definition plus homestead-ready outer layer.

name: Black cream houndstooth pea coat
description: Mid-length double-breasted pea/overcoat in large black-and-cream houndstooth with wide notched lapels, large black buttons, structured shoulders, and black lining.
rating_reason: Shoulders and lapels balance pear beautifully and look polished, but high contrast is harsh for Soft Autumn and cream shows dirt.

name: Beige five-pocket twill shorts
description: Light tan cotton twill shorts with belt loops, button fly, and classic five-pocket styling. Mid-rise with a finished mid-thigh hem.
rating_reason: Muted warm tan is Soft Autumn excellent and sturdy for summer chores; standard cut is neutrally pear.

name: DENIZEN tan khaki shorts
description: Sandy beige DENIZEN chino shorts in cotton twill with belt loops, top button, and finished mid-thigh hems. Classic casual khaki silhouette.
rating_reason: Same Soft Autumn neutral strength and homestead practicality as other khaki shorts; keep one strong pair if duplicates overlap.

name: Oatmeal charcoal stripe pocket dress
description: Short-sleeve shallow V-neck midi dress in muted oatmeal and charcoal horizontal stripes with large front patch pockets. Relaxed straight linen/cotton-blend look.
rating_reason: Soft Autumn stripes and practical pockets win, but boxy cut plus hip-level pockets can widen pear without a belt.

name: Olive smocked Swiss-dot maxi dress
description: Muted olive maxi with smocked bodice, square neck, short flutter ruffle sleeves, and a tiered skirt with lace/crochet insets. Subtle Swiss-dot texture throughout.
rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn green; smocked waist and flowing tiers are textbook pear flattery with feminine homestead ease.

name: Dusty rose Joy Strength floral tee
description: Short-sleeve crew tee in muted dusty rose with a centered floral cluster graphic and vertical white text reading JOY and STRENGTH. Soft jersey casual fit.
rating_reason: Warm Soft Autumn base and soft florals feel joyful and wearable; tuck for pear waist definition.

name: Cognac faux-leather moto jacket
description: Waist-length cognac faux-leather moto with stand collar, front zip, quilted shoulder/upper-arm panels, multiple silver zip pockets, and snap cuffs.
rating_reason: Signature Soft Autumn cognac; cropped waist and shoulder quilting strongly balance pear while staying wipeable and polished.

name: Cognac knee-high riding boots
description: Tall knee-high riding-style boots in warm muted brown leather-look material with rounded toe, flat/low heel, and full inner zipper. Visible scuffing and wear at ankle and heel.
rating_reason: Soft Autumn color and tall shafts help balance hips for homestead wear, but heavy wear may need replacing soon. (Shoes, not clothing.)

name: Tan strappy sport sandals
description: Outdoor strappy sandals with muted tan woven straps, toe loop, adjustable black buckle at the ankle, and a thick dark contoured footbed. (Shoes; olive maxi hem also visible but not the focus.)
rating_reason: Earthy Soft Autumn straps and serious homestead practicality for NW Arkansas summers. (Shoes, not clothing.)

name: Black speckled marled sweater
description: Deep black crew-neck knit sweater with white/light-gray flecks throughout a marled speckled texture. Relaxed boxy silhouette with ribbed neck, cuffs, and hem.
rating_reason: Cozy and dirt-hiding, but base black is Soft Autumn poor; boxy fit skips pear waist definition.

name: White canvas slip-on sneakers
description: Low-profile white canvas laceless slip-ons with side elastic goring and flat white rubber soles. Visible scuffing and dirt from wear.
rating_reason: Handy slip-ons for busy mom life, but stark white clashes Soft Autumn and shows homestead dirt fast. (Shoes, not clothing.)
